<description>
On illumos-based distributions whose GCC is built with the `--enable-clocale=dragonfly` option (e.g. OmniOS, OpenIndiana), the `std::ctype<char>::~ctype()` destructor passes an uninitialized value to `freelocale()`.

Constructing and destroying `std::locale("")` in `SetupEnvironment()` therefore intermittently crashes, e.g. with "libc thread failure: lfree() called with a misaligned pointer".

Upstream reports:
- https://github.com/illumos/gcc/pull/56#issuecomment-5933176361
- https://github.com/omniosorg/omnios-build/issues/4253
- https://www.illumos.org/issues/18481

Closes https://github.com/hebasto/bitcoin-core-nightly/issues/315.
</description>
